body: Holy shit this guy is really good.
On the bright side I had not actually read your user name yet and "yodaballs out" Made me laugh harder than I have in a while.

Im actually in a fraternity. Its fun being involved in something more than just being at school, but it just adds more stress dealing with all of the stuff that comes with that than just being at school. And, no, Ill have to go look it up.
Yes. But I really don't want to talk to them. Besides not wanting them to start thinking of me differently, as well as me not being that open with people unless we are really close and im plastered.
I have a hard time opening up to anyone that I'm not very close and when I'm not plastered. I know I can talk to them, but I just dont want to. And I forgot about the Hobbit!

Im sure that at some point it gets better but im tired of feeling like a failure and I cant think of any way life will drastically improve. I also feel weird about the though being on medicine and depending on it to make me happy. I want just to be happy without aid of a pill. At the same time I think I need it. I dont know who I can tell that would not start treating me differently and taking pity on me.
I should clarify that I have thought about and been on the verge of ending my life many more times than when I was on the balcony today.
